paper_title: Constraints on axionlike particles with H.E.S.S. from the irregularity of the PKS 2155-304 energy spectrum
notes: H.E.S.S. observations of PKS 2155-304 constrain ALP-photon coupling via spectral irregularity. Conservative galaxy-cluster limit g_gamma_a < 2.1e-11 GeV^-1 for ALP mass 15-60 neV at 95% C.L. (encoded as horizontal line). An additional optimistic IGMF-based limit ~5e-11 GeV^-1 near 1 neV is also quoted but is less robust. Limits from stellar/astrophysical gamma-ray propagation, so no local DM density applies.
